description:
The 99 Mile Cross Country Ski Trails are groomed and maintained by the 100 Mile Nordic Ski Society. Please visit their website at 100 Mile Nordics for more information regarding seasons passes, day passes, lodge operating hours, and ski conditions.

The trail network boasts 45 km of groomed ski trails, 5 km of lit trails for night skiing and 6.5 km of snowshoe trails.
directions: From 100 Mile House, travel about 2 km south on Hwy 97 and turn right onto Ainsworth Road. Watch for cross country ski signs on the highway as you approach the turnoff. Follow Ainsworth Road for about 1.5 km and turn right to reach the parking area for the trails.
